text.测试包尚未经过 Apple 公证。从网上下载的 App 带有隔离标记，macOS: Test builds are not notarized by Apple yet. Apps downloaded from the internet carry a quarantine flag, so macOS reports “Peach is damaged and can't be opened”. This command removes the quarantine flag from Peach only; run it again after installing a new version.
